matching_scope: Standalone synthetic references only. Not matched to Native reserves, history, acquired lexical signs, material receipts, timing or training costs.

primary_grid.per_trajectory_initial_memory: New conventional policy state and empty environment cache. Not a new Native learner.
primary_grid.shared_seed: Same initial environmental seed per policy, but futures evolve under its own actions. No forced equal future after different actions.

proposal_agenda.choice_requires_Root_freeze: Select one of the next two precisely declared alternatives; do not silently combine them.
proposal_agenda.integrated_task_alternation: Goal0/clasifica for5/20 of horizon, goal1/equilibra for7/20, goal0/clasifica for8/20. Two unequal goal reversals, but word and goal co-vary; this estimates integrated performance, not isolated attention adaptation.
proposal_agenda.goal_only_isolation: Keep clasifica fixed throughout. Same0→1→0 goal reversals and5:7:8 durations; balance is not tested in this grid. A separate fixed equilibra grid would add48 trajectories and must be explicitly authorized.
proposal_agenda.changes: At both boundaries mutate source values via the same fixed RNG and increment versions without clearing the previous cache. No mutation picked by usefulness. Rotate source order by1 at the second boundary; preserve bin state and policy state.

information_contract.after_effect: Binary useful/unsuccessful consequence from actual effect. Conventional policy may retain its own prior observations/actions/feedback.
information_contract.downstream_executor: Fixed conventional relation20 and prepared task-word map, legitimate environment cache and actions; not acquired semantic comparison or Native decision. Its costs and extra preparation are explicitly separate.
information_contract.cursor: Prepared circular next-source order regardless of action. Not learned source-address selection.
